http/internal/http2_life#

Stream states (RFC 9113 §5.1) and client stream identifiers.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Stream states (RFC 9113 §5.1) and client stream identifiers. Push is off, so there are no reserved states.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.

object Http2StreamLife#

object Http2StreamLife

No reserved states: push is disabled. Message semantics (informational/final heads, trailers, DATA lengths) and actual reset output belong to the owner.

Http2StreamLife.discarding#

discarding() is bool

Inspect BEFORE applying a received frame. A final accepted frame closes the state but its data must still be delivered. Closed frames require minimal HPACK/connection-flow processing before discarding application data.
